title: Bayberry Cove
subtitle: A little place on Lake Michigan

residents.name: June Bell
residents.intro: I always make one extra cherry turnover for a traveler. It just feels right.
residents.late: The ovens are cooling, but I'll be back before sunrise!

residents.name: Mateo Rivera
residents.intro: The lake looks different every morning. You should see it before the gulls wake.
residents.late: Tomorrow, find me at the water. Bring your curiosity.

residents.name: Ellen Park
residents.intro: Maples, birches, goldenrod… our little shore has more stories than you think.
residents.late: The flowers need sleep, too. We'll look again in the morning.

residents.name: Cal Walker
residents.intro: The dunes are always moving, even when they look perfectly still.
residents.late: Good evening. The path lanterns will guide you back.

residents.name: Nadia Brooks
residents.intro: I keep a handwritten map of every secret little corner of this town.
residents.late: The best chapters always end somewhere warm.

residents.name: Dot Miller
residents.intro: A town is nothing without people who stop to say hello. So—hello!
residents.late: The stars over the lake are worth staying up for.
